corpus: 21 events from the two benchmark clips processed with the default configuration and fixtures/zones/*.json (pedestrian_area: 7 person zone-entry events; rush_hour: 14 car events). Event ids are deterministic.

annotation.method: Relevance judged from the saved mid-frame crop of each event's tracked box, viewed on a contact sheet BEFORE any model ranked the events. One reviewer. Events whose crops did not settle a query are listed as 'ambiguous' and are ignored for that query (neither relevant nor wrong).
annotation.caveat: The reviewer wrote the queries after seeing the crops, so queries are ones the corpus can answer. Eleven queries and 21 events: descriptive only.

queries.q: person leaning out of a car window
car with a visible licence plate
